summary: The v60 swallowed stethoscope case reaches the hero one-line status report and stops because js/insight.js:ustatusline refuses the u.ustuck branch. Upstream insight.c:ustatusline appends the held or swallowed wording, calls do_name.c:a_monnam(u.ustuck), and prints the status line. The queue labels the callee a_monnam as the source, but the implementation defect is the caller refusal in ustatusline; do_name.js already ports a_monnam and its swallowed ARTICLE_THE rule.

source.branch: While applying a stethoscope in place (or probing the hero with a wand), u.ustuck is non-null. ustatusline selects swallowed versus held/holding wording, appends a_monnam(u.ustuck), then prints Status of the hero; for a swallowed hero, a_monnam follows x_monnam’s special ARTICLE_THE rule.
callers: apply.c:use_stethoscope calls ustatusline when the stethoscope is used in place (u.dx == 0 and u.dy == 0).
zap.c:zapyourself calls ustatusline after a wand of probing processes hero inventory.
JavaScript callers are apply.js:use_stethoscope and zap.js:zapyourself; both import ustatusline from insight.js.
dependencies: do_name.c:a_monnam delegates to x_monnam with ARTICLE_A and SUPPRESS_SADDLE for named monsters; x_monnam changes the article to ARTICLE_THE when u.uswallow and the monster is u.ustuck. js/do_name.js already implements these branches.
mondata.h:digests and mondata.c:sticks select the swallowed, held, or holding phrase before the monster name is appended.

evidence: The saved v60 admission entry uses manifest membership hash 8d47d06f16ee303a31fae9b2226419578a27facb04cdf34ad408e2971932f5b0, recording hash b8d2ce77c958ca0521e72c67aa7e141e22fdefec45380cf96aff31906f408f33, and baseline evaluation challenges/evaluations/admission-b151b2318fa82ab62868ad676c7f00823de614c0-v60.json at b151b2318fa82ab62868ad676c7f00823de614c0. It records 359/527 screens and cursors, 3119/3252 RNG calls, and 168 remaining screens.

The queue’s first mismatch is step 359, kind stop: js/insight.js reports “the attributes window requires a_monnam() for u.ustuck”. The text comes from UnsupportedEnlightenmentError at ustatusline’s u.ustuck guard; the command route is a stethoscope in-place status report, as confirmed by apply.c:use_stethoscope -> ustatusline and the case recording.

Upstream insight.c:ustatusline (3402-3488) handles non-null u.ustuck by appending “being digested by” or “engulfed by” when swallowed, otherwise “held by” or “holding” according to sticks(youmonst.data), then appending a_monnam(u.ustuck). It prints the completed status line after adding any applicable conditions.

The corresponding js/insight.js:ustatusline implements preceding clauses but throws UnsupportedEnlightenmentError when u.ustuck is set, before the C-supported wording, naming call, and final ttyPline. js/do_name.js:a_monnam already delegates to x_monnam; x_monnam implements the swallowed u.ustuck article override required by do_name.c:831-844, so the defect is local to insight.c:ustatusline rather than do_name.c:a_monnam.

The scope is a divergence fix for insight.c:ustatusline’s u.ustuck branch and its existing production callers, replacing that placeholder refusal with the source’s output and preserving naming/RNG behavior. The selected v60 recording exercises the swallowed branch; tests should also cover held and holding variants from C conditions.
